description: This file defines an internal sealed class NatsConnectionManager that manages connections, stream initialization, message enqueueing, consumer creation, and acknowledgements for NATS and JetStream integrations within the Orleans streaming framework.

classes.name: NatsConnectionManager
classes.description: Manages NATS and JetStream connections, streams, message enqueueing, and consumers within Orleans streaming provider.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Establishes connection to NATS server, checks for JetStream availability, and creates the stream if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: EnqueueMessage
methods.description: Enqueues a message to the appropriate NATS JetStream stream subject.

methods.name: CreateConsumer
methods.description: Creates a new NatsStreamConsumer for a specific partition.

methods.name: AcknowledgeMessages
methods.description: Sends an acknowledgment for processed messages on a given subject.
